name: Executive Overview

notes.title: Pitch It. Prove It. Propel It.
notes.text: VentureX is a national-level investor-connect program that brings promising startups and potential investors under one roof.

bio: VentureX is a national-level investor-connect program designed to bring promising startups and potential investors under one roof. It gives aspiring entrepreneurs a platform to pitch their ventures, showcase their innovations, and present their business potential to investors.

VentureX is an entrepreneurial pitching platform by E-Cell, BMSIT&M. The journey begins with an online preliminary round, where teams submit startup pitches and video demonstrations for investors to explore and evaluate.

Selected teams advance to the next stage, presenting their products, business models, and vision through live pitches to a panel of investors. It is an opportunity to showcase innovation, attract investment, and take the next step towards building a successful venture.

name: FAQs

notes.title: Open innovation
notes.text: Startups from any domain or industry are welcome to participate.

bio: VentureX welcomes student teams with startup ideas from any industry. Use these quick answers to check eligibility, team composition, and the participation fee information provided in the event document.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to participate?
faqs.answer: Students enrolled in accredited higher education institutions across India are eligible.

faqs.question: Is there an entry fee?
faqs.answer: Round 1 (online video submission) is free. Teams shortlisted for the Round 2 offline finale pay an administrative confirmation fee that covers venue access, food, connectivity, and kits. The amount has not yet been confirmed.

faqs.question: What are the team size parameters?
faqs.answer: Teams must comprise 3 to 4 members. Cross-college and inter-departmental team compositions are permitted.

faqs.question: Is there a specific domain or track for startups?
faqs.answer: No. VentureX follows an Open Innovation approach, so startups from any domain or industry are welcome to participate.
